identity_boundary.summary: Ethan-CTO is a persistent role-brain in ystar-company. Codex and Claude Code are execution substrates. Tool sessions do not own Ethan's identity, memory, or authority.

execution_channels.role: bounded delegated coding and analysis channel
execution_channels.risk_notes: Can act as Ethan's delegated execution instance only when scoped by Ethan brain refs, task packet, and governance boundary.
not_allowed_for: writing directly to long-term brain without curation

execution_channels.role: bounded delegated local repo navigation and code-edit channel
allowed_for: local task execution under explicit instruction
execution_channels.risk_notes: May instantiate Ethan's delegated work context, but does not become Ethan.
not_allowed_for: treating terminal context as canonical memory

execution_channels.risk_notes: Shell commands can mutate state; high-risk commands require explicit scope and review.

execution_channels.role: remote repository coordination and evidence channel
allowed_for: commit and review evidence under user control
execution_channels.risk_notes: GitHub may carry evidence and collaboration artifacts but never owns Ethan's identity.
not_allowed_for: governance approval by repository state alone

execution_channels.role: future bounded OpenClaw execution substrate if validated by existing runtime indexes
allowed_for: future delegated execution under explicit task and governance envelope
execution_channels.risk_notes: Referenced as future substrate only; no runtime behavior is implemented here.

evidence_return_policy: Execution result must be summarized back into CIEU/report/memory pathway.
Failed execution should produce residual/open gap.
Successful execution should link commit/test evidence where available.
Tool session context should not become canonical memory without curation.
prohibited_interpretations: unreviewed tool output can write directly into long-term brain
open_gaps: No automatic CIEU return path from Codex or Claude Code yet.
No validated task packet launcher yet.
No execution-channel risk policy enforcement yet.
